quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ

parent_channels.name: Moral Boundary, Repair, and Returned Judgment

subchannels.name: Truth Enacted as Recognized Good
subchannels.scene_or_process: A truthful deed becomes socially and morally recognizable as goodness, obedience, and beneficence.
subchannels.active_motifs: enacted truth `ب ر ر:B001/m01`; expansive good and obedience `ب ر ر:B002/m01`; recognized good `ع ر ف:B005/m01`; willing obedience `د ي ن:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Truth is not only a proposition here but conduct that proceeds into action. Its social face is the good that sound judgment recognizes, while its relational form is willing obedience.

subchannels.name: Sin, Crime, and Transgression
subchannels.scene_or_process: An actor crosses a limit, turns breach into an offense, and bears the identity and consequence of wrongdoing.
subchannels.active_motifs: punishable sin `ء ث م:B003/m01`; crime or culpable offense `ج ر م:B004/m01`; crossing the just limit `ع د و:B001/m01`; violation of right and restraint `ف ج ر:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs form a single moral sequence: breach of a boundary becomes a defined offense, the offense identifies its agent, and culpability makes punishment intelligible.

subchannels.name: Abstention, Renunciation, and Expiation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A wrongdoer withdraws from sin, disavows the offense, and covers its remaining liability through expiation.
subchannels.active_motifs: refraining from sin `ء ث م:B002/m01`; renunciation of implicated conduct `ك ف ر:B005/m01`; covering or erasing sin by expiation `ك ف ر:B009/m01`; return to broad good `ب ر ر:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Abstention begins the repair, renunciation separates the actor from the wrong, and expiation addresses what remains. The scene closes by re-entry into active good rather than mere nonparticipation.

subchannels.name: Imputation, Suspicion, and Confession
subchannels.scene_or_process: Guilt is placed upon someone, entertained as an accusation, denied or admitted, and converted into accountable speech.
subchannels.active_motifs: loading sin onto another `ء ث م:B004/m01`; accusatory suspicion `ظ ن ن:B004/m01`; charging someone with falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; confession and acknowledgment `ع ر ف:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Imputation supplies the charge, suspicion supplies its uncertain social circulation, and confession reverses that uncertainty by making responsibility explicit.

subchannels.name: Moral Delay and Abandonment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Good is not rejected outright but deferred through slackness until prior companionship or obligation is left behind.
subchannels.active_motifs: lagging behind good `ء ث م:B001/m01`; slackness and failure to exert oneself `ء ل ي:B008/m01`; delay and detention `ء ل ي:B013/m01`; leaving after accompaniment `ت ل و:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The scene captures a quieter moral failure than open transgression. Delay becomes a mode of neglect, and prolonged neglect ends in abandonment of what had once been followed.

subchannels.name: Recompense Returning to Its Source
subchannels.scene_or_process: A deed reaches its outcome, returns to its doer as payment, and fixes the final moral condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: recompense returning to the worker `ث و ب:B002/m01`; reckoning and requital `د ي ن:B002/m01`; return to final outcome `ء و ل:B002/m01`; reversal and return `ق ل ب:B005/m01`; falling into ruin `و ي ل:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Recompense is figured as a return rather than an external addition. The deed travels toward its end, turns back upon its source, and resolves either as due payment or ruin.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Conduct is measured by whether it preserves or crosses a moral limit, then returns to the actor as blame, repair, or recompense.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same cycle extends backward to delay before good and forward to confession, renunciation, and expiation.

parent_channels.name: Measure, Exchange, and Liability

subchannels.name: Fair Measure Against Concealed Shortfall
subchannels.scene_or_process: A quantity is measured, checked against justice, and either delivered in full or reduced to another party's loss.
subchannels.active_motifs: deficient measure `ط ف ف:B003/m01`; measuring food `ك ي ل:B001/m01`; loss through measure and weight `خ س ر:B003/m01`; just balance `و ز ن:B002/m01`; completion without deficiency `و ف ي:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The measuring instrument mediates between the parties. Justice requires that the measured amount and the delivered amount coincide; any hidden reduction converts exchange into injury.

subchannels.name: Brim, Fullness, and the Last Increment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vessel or quantity approaches its rim, is compared with a nearby amount, and passes from near-full to complete.
subchannels.active_motifs: the rim of a measure `ط ف ف:B002/m01`; overflowing fullness `ض ح ك:B008/m01`; approximation in amount `ق ر ب:B016/m01`; encompassing totality `ك ل ل:B003/m01`; complete fulfillment `و ف ي:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: These motifs isolate the boundary at which a small increment matters. The brim marks a measurable threshold, approximation brings the amount close, and fulfillment removes the residual gap.

subchannels.name: Market Bargain, Demand, and Price
subchannels.scene_or_process: Buyers and sellers negotiate an item while demand establishes its market standing and price.
subchannels.active_motifs: market demand and briskness `ق و م:B018/m01`; bargaining over an affair `ق و ل:B009/m01`; comparison between alternatives `ك ي ل:B005/m01`; valuation and pricing `ق و م:B010/m01`; commercial loss `خ س ر:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Negotiation tests alternatives, demand gives the item a market position, and pricing turns that position into an exchange value. A failed bargain or adverse market converts value into commercial loss.

subchannels.name: Debt, Cash, Credit, and Earning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Present money is distinguished from deferred liability, a loan advances resources, and earning supplies repayment.
subchannels.active_motifs: financial debt `د ي ن:B003/m01`; cash on hand `ع ي ن:B011/m01`; advance or loan `ع ي ن:B012/m01`; earning livelihood and gain `ك س ب:B001/m01`; transferring benefit to another `ك س ب:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Cash and credit occupy different points in one transfer cycle. The loan moves value before repayment, while earning restores the debtor's capacity to discharge the deferred claim.

subchannels.name: Surety, Pledge, and Dependent Burden
subchannels.scene_or_process: A guarantor stands behind a measured obligation, a pledge follows its holder, and liability carries a dependent weight.
subchannels.active_motifs: personal surety `ك و ن:B003/m01`; a right or pledge following its owner `ت ل و:B004/m01`; measured food as the secured object `ك ي ل:B001/m01`; dependent burden `ك ل ل:B002/m01`; custody of an entrusted object `ح ف ظ:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The obligation is made portable by attaching it to persons and things. The pledge follows its owner, the surety stands in reserve, and the dependent burden names what must still be carried.

subchannels.name: Equivalence, Alignment, and Appraisal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two things are placed in correspondence, aligned, and judged for equality, substitution, or relative worth.
subchannels.active_motifs: balancing two things in alignment `و ز ن:B003/m01`; equal measured amount `ق و م:B015/m01`; matching like with like `ن ظ ر:B006/m01`; acting as another's equivalent or proxy `ق و م:B007/m01`; comparative appraisal `ك ي ل:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Equivalence is produced by a procedure, not assumed. Alignment makes differences visible, appraisal tests them, and substitution becomes legitimate only when the compared positions are made commensurate.

subchannels.name: Precious Good, Competition, and Hoarding
subchannels.scene_or_process: A scarce valued object attracts competing claimants, rises in demand, and may be withheld rather than circulated.
subchannels.active_motifs: precious object competed for `ن ف س:B010/m01`; market demand `ق و م:B018/m01`; hoarding wealth `م س ك:B002/m01`; earning or acquisition `ك س ب:B001/m01`; present cash `ع ي ن:B011/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Preciousness generates desire, competition intensifies demand, acquisition transfers control, and hoarding interrupts recirculation of the valued resource.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Goods, values, and obligations are made commensurable so that transfer can be completed without hidden shortfall.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 83:1-3 names deficient measuring, taking in full, weighing, and causing loss.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Physical measure opens into market demand, pricing, debt, cash, surety, and delegated equivalence.

parent_channels.name: Temporal Course, Occurrence, and Terminal Change

subchannels.name: Beginning, Endpoint, and Completion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A process starts, advances toward its limit, and is brought to a completed close.
subchannels.active_motifs: first beginning `ء و ل:B001/m01`; endpoint and termination `ء ل ي:B001/m01`; reaching the final part `خ ت م:B001/m01`; complete fulfillment `و ف ي:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The temporal line is framed from both ends. Beginning establishes priority, the endpoint supplies direction, and completion certifies that no unfinished remainder persists.

subchannels.name: Duration, Passage, and Recurrence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Time is experienced as a bounded day, an extended period, a repeated occurrence, and a passage that eventually cuts off.
subchannels.active_motifs: bounded daytime `ي و م:B001/m01`; duration or period `ي و م:B002/m01`; temporal recurrence `م ر ر:B002/m01`; occurrence in time `ك و ن:B001/m01`; completed and severed duration `ج ر م:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Recurrence gives duration internal rhythm, while occurrence gives each passage a definite presence. Completion closes the period by cutting it off from what follows.

subchannels.name: Waiting, Respite, and Imminence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claimant waits, an interval opens, and the awaited event moves from deferment into nearness.
subchannels.active_motifs: waiting and delay `ء ي ي:B001/m01`; granting respite `ن ظ ر:B002/m01`; breadth of time and interval `ن ف س:B015/m01`; approaching expiration `ق ر ب:B002/m01`; detained delay `ء ل ي:B013/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Respite is a structured interval between demand and event. Waiting occupies the interval, nearness contracts it, and expiration ends the possibility of further deferment.

subchannels.name: Calamitous Event and Rising
subchannels.scene_or_process: A severe occurrence arrives as the event of a day, rouses what was still, and brings a collective rising.
subchannels.active_motifs: the day's calamitous occurrence `ي و م:B003/m01`; an adverse state coming to pass `ك و ن:B006/m01`; bitter ordeal `م ر ر:B004/m01`; overwhelming calamity `ع ظ م:B004/m01`; resurrection and rising `ق و م:B013/m01`; rousing from stillness `ب ع ث:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Event, severity, and rising form one eschatological mechanism. The day is not a neutral date but an occurrence that breaks stasis, gathers bodies into standing, and fixes an adverse or saving outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Events occupy a bounded course with a beginning, recurrence, delay, approach, and completed outcome.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 83:4-6,11,34 repeatedly anchors a coming day, rising, and temporal reckoning.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Ordinary duration expands into respite, cyclical passage, catastrophic occurrence, and resurrection.

parent_channels.name: Record, Inscription, and Authentication

subchannels.name: Written Line and Numbered Record
subchannels.scene_or_process: Characters are arranged into a line and fixed as a legible, numbered record.
subchannels.active_motifs: written text `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; numbered inscription `ر ق م:B001/m01`; aligned written line `س ط ر:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Joining letters creates the written object, alignment makes it readable, and numbering or inscription gives the record a stable identity that can be consulted again.

subchannels.name: Seal, Impression, and Secure Closure
subchannels.scene_or_process: A completed record or vessel receives an identifying impression and is closed against alteration.
subchannels.active_motifs: seal impression `خ ت م:B002/m01`; secure sealing that prevents access `خ ت م:B003/m01`; inscribed line beneath the seal `ر ق م:B001/m01`; terminal completion `خ ت م:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Completion and authentication coincide. The impression identifies what has been closed, while the secured closure preserves the integrity of the content.

subchannels.name: Decree, Enrollment, and Roster
subchannels.scene_or_process: A name is entered into a register and the inscription acquires binding legal force.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding written determination `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; enrollment in a register or class `ك ت ب:B004/m01`; reckoning attached to the decree `د ي ن:B002/m01`; affirmative confirmation `ن ع م:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Enrollment locates a person within an ordered group, and the written determination turns classification into consequence. Confirmation closes the administrative act.

subchannels.name: Visible Mark, Brand, and Landmark
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible trace distinguishes an animal, object, route, or place and guides later recognition.
subchannels.active_motifs: decorative or visible pattern `ر ق م:B003/m01`; branded traces on an animal `ر ق م:B004/m01`; terrain trace or named landmark `ر ق م:B005/m01`; distinguishing sign `ع ل م:B002/m01`; witnessing emblem `ش ه د:B008/m01`; raised banner `ر ء ي:B011/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: A mark converts surface into memory. On bodies it identifies ownership or condition, on land it preserves location, and as a banner it enlarges the same identifying function for a group.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An event or identity is made durable and publicly recoverable through writing, marking, enrollment, and sealing.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 83:7-9 and 83:18-21 repeat `كِتَاب` and `مَرْقُوم`, while 83:25-26 repeats sealing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Documentary fixation extends into animal brands, terrain marks, banners, rosters, and binding decrees.

parent_channels.name: Voice, Report, and Contested Claim

subchannels.name: Articulation and the Body of Voice
subchannels.scene_or_process: Breath and tongue produce an audible utterance whose clarity and volume give speech a bodily presence.
subchannels.active_motifs: spoken utterance `ق و ل:B001/m01`; tongue as speech instrument `ق و ل:B002/m01`; articulate mobility of the tongue `ب ل ل:B006/m01`; body and projection of voice `ج ر م:B008/m01`; vocal clamor `ب ر ر:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The tongue shapes the utterance, breath projects it, and vocal body determines whether it emerges as clear speech or clamor. The scene joins anatomy to communicative force.

subchannels.name: Repeated Call and Answering Voice
subchannels.scene_or_process: A call is repeated, another voice follows it, and the exchange becomes correspondence or response.
subchannels.active_motifs: reiterated call `ث و ب:B004/m01`; one voice following another `ت ل و:B007/m01`; reciprocal correspondence `ر س ل:B008/m01`; responsive affirmation `ه ا ء:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Repetition keeps the summons active until an answering voice enters. Following, replying, and corresponding turn isolated sound into a relational exchange.

subchannels.name: Rumor, Banter, and Public Reputation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A report circulates among people, becomes entertaining talk, and affects a person's reputation.
subchannels.active_motifs: widely circulating report `ق و ل:B007/m01`; witty or entertaining talk `ف ك ه:B003/m01`; talk that consumes reputations `ف ك ه:B007/m01`; remote village as circulation setting `ك ف ر:B012/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Circulation detaches speech from its first speaker. Banter makes it socially attractive, while talk about others turns entertainment into reputational consumption across the settlement.

subchannels.name: False Attribution and Fabricated Narrative
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker invents a claim, attributes it to another, and gives the invention the shape of a received story.
subchannels.active_motifs: false attribution to another `ت ل و:B009/m01`; saying what did not occur `ق و ل:B005/m01`; direct falsehood `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`; charging another with lying `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; invented narrative `ف ع ل:B004/m01`; false tales `س ط ر:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Fabrication supplies the invented content, attribution relocates its source, and narration gives the result enough form to circulate as inherited story rather than obvious invention.

subchannels.name: Deliberation, Bargaining, and Adjudicative Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants exchange views, compare positions, resist one another, and authorize a practical judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: negotiation over an affair `ق و ل:B009/m01`; comparative bargaining `ك ي ل:B005/m01`; reciprocal deliberation `ن ظ ر:B010/m01`; resistance or contest `ق و م:B014/m01`; imposed ruling `ق و ل:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Deliberation opens positions to comparison, bargaining tests their practical terms, and resistance clarifies the dispute. Adjudicative speech ends the exchange by imposing an operative result.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Speech moves from bodily articulation through response and circulation to negotiation, fabrication, or public attribution.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 83:13,17,32 repeatedly stages saying, recitation, denial, and attributed judgment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The speech field includes vocal texture, alternating voices, rumor in a settlement, bargaining, and fabricated narrative.

parent_channels.name: Reference, Relation, and Discourse Commitment

subchannels.name: Question, Demonstration, and Attention
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker directs attention to a referent, asks which or what it is, and frames the inquiry as a presentation.
subchannels.active_motifs: interrogative selection `ء ي ي:B004/m01`; demonstrative pointing `ذ و و:B003/m01`; interrogative or relative “what” `ذ و و:B004/m01`; attention-opening particle `ه ا ء:B002/m01`; presentational inquiry `ر ء ي:B013/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Pointing establishes a candidate referent, inquiry requests its specification, and the attention marker makes the referent jointly available to speaker and hearer.

subchannels.name: Joining, Accompaniment, and Relative Attachment
subchannels.scene_or_process: One expression is attached to another so that accompaniment, possession, or relative dependence can be read as a single construction.
subchannels.active_motifs: accompaniment and inclusion `ء ل ي:B003/m01`; joining one item to another `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; relative attachment `ذ و و:B002/m01`; relation expressed by an “on/above” preposition `ع ل و:B012/m01`; relational particle `ر ب ب:B015/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Joining supplies structural cohesion, while the relational terms specify how the joined expressions depend on one another. The construction moves from mere adjacency to interpretable accompaniment or possession.

subchannels.name: Affirmation, Oath, and Pledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A proposition is affirmed, introduced under oath, and made binding through a pledge that follows its bearer.
subchannels.active_motifs: affirmative answer `ن ع م:B004/m01`; oath-opening affirmation `ء ي ي:B010/m01`; swearing an oath `ء ل ي:B007/m01`; following pledge or obligation `ت ل و:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Affirmation accepts the proposition, the oath heightens commitment to it, and the pledge gives that commitment a durable relation to the person responsible.

subchannels.name: Correction, Resumption, and Responsive Assent
subchannels.scene_or_process: Discourse interrupts a prior inference, redirects it, and resumes with an explicit answer.
subchannels.active_motifs: corrective resumption `ب ل ل:B008/m01`; responsive assent `ه ا ء:B003/m01`; affirmative answer `ن ع م:B004/m01`; statement presented with conjectural force `ق و ل:B011/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Correction blocks the prior trajectory without ending discourse. The response then supplies a new commitment, and the conjectural statement marks the proposition being revised or accepted.

subchannels.name: Definition, Essence, and Signification
subchannels.scene_or_process: A thing is isolated as itself, assigned a limit or definition, and allowed to signify its condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: essence or selfsame identity `ن ف س:B012/m01`; the thing itself `ع ي ن:B013/m01`; defining limit `ق و ل:B016/m01`; a thing's indicative “saying” `ق و ل:B014/m01`; locus where a quality is expected `ظ ن ن:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Identity supplies the referent, definition gives it a boundary, and signification lets its state communicate beyond explicit speech. The locus motif grounds abstract definition in where a property is expected to reside.

subchannels.name: Letter, Pronunciation, and Rhyme
subchannels.scene_or_process: A named letter is pronounced and positioned so that it can govern the terminal sound of a verse or utterance.
subchannels.active_motifs: the letter hāʾ `ه ا ء:B006/m01`; directing the rhyme ending `و ج ه:B011/m01`; articulate tongue `ب ل ل:B006/m01`; written line `س ط ر:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The letter supplies the phonetic unit, articulation realizes it, and rhyme-direction fixes its position at a formal boundary. Writing gives the same ordered sound a visual line.

subchannels.name: Vocative Address and Pronominal Focus
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker calls a near or distant addressee and fixes that person as the focused object of warning or presentation.
subchannels.active_motifs: near or distant vocative `ء ي ي:B008/m01`; emphatic pronominal support `ء ي ي:B005/m01`; presentational “take” particle `ه ا ء:B001/m01`; demonstrative pointing `ذ و و:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The vocative opens contact, the pronoun fixes the addressee's grammatical role, and presentation makes the pointed object or warning immediate.

subchannels.name: Enumeration and Explanatory Expansion
subchannels.scene_or_process: An expression introduces a large count or gathered plurality and then expands it through an explanatory gloss.
subchannels.active_motifs: indefinite large number `ء ي ي:B007/m01`; explanatory “that is” `ء ي ي:B009/m01`; numerous gathered groups `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; grouped multitudes `ك ل ل:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Enumeration opens an unspecified plurality, grouped nouns give it collective form, and explanatory expansion clarifies what the count or group comprises.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Linguistic operators locate a referent, join it to another term, open or correct discourse, and bind speakers to propositions.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; interrogative and demonstrative forms occur at 83:8,13,17,19,26,32, while 83:14 uses `بَلْ` and 83:31 uses `إِلَىٰ`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Function words form scenes of pointing, questioning, oath-taking, correction, essence-definition, and even letter and rhyme construction.

parent_channels.name: Trust, Worship, and Ritual Response

subchannels.name: Security, Assent, and Entrusted Belief
subchannels.scene_or_process: The heart becomes secure, accepts a proposition, and entrusts itself to what it affirms.
subchannels.active_motifs: settled security of heart `ء م ن:B001/m01`; trusted assent `ء م ن:B002/m01`; belief and delegation `د ي ن:B007/m01`; affirmative confirmation `ن ع م:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Security removes destabilizing fear, assent accepts the claim, and delegation places practical reliance upon it. Affirmation voices the inner settlement.

subchannels.name: Standing Observance and Prayer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshiper assumes the bodily posture of prayer and maintains the practice through repeated observance.
subchannels.active_motifs: prescribed prayer `ص ل ي:B001/m01`; standing posture `ق و م:B002/m01`; persevering observance `ح ف ظ:B003/m01`; obedient submission `د ي ن:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Posture embodies worship, while preservation through repetition turns a single act into observance. Obedience supplies the relation that makes the posture devotional rather than merely physical.

subchannels.name: Invocation, Rain Prayer, and Amen
subchannels.scene_or_process: A community calls for mercy or rain, repeats the summons, and answers the petition with “amen.”
subchannels.active_motifs: supplication and blessing `ص ل ي:B002/m01`; prayer for rain `س ق ي:B006/m01`; repeated summons `ث و ب:B004/m01`; “amen” seeking response `ء م ن:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Supplication supplies the request, rain prayer gives it a concrete communal need, repetition keeps the appeal active, and “amen” converts listeners into participants seeking fulfillment.

subchannels.name: Offering, Sacred Nearness, and Pilgrimage Standing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshiper approaches through an offering, joins a witnessed sacred standing, and enters a favored proximity.
subchannels.active_motifs: offering that brings nearness `ق ر ب:B005/m01`; pilgrimage standing at ʿArafah `ع ر ف:B007/m01`; witnessed presence `ش ه د:B001/m01`; privileged nearness `ق ر ب:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The offering is the approach mechanism, standing is the embodied ritual setting, and witnessed presence confirms participation. Nearness becomes both spatial movement and conferred status.

subchannels.name: Ostentatious Devotion

subchannels.name: Submission, Humility, and Worshipful Rule

parent_channels.name: Authority, Custody, and Legal Status

subchannels.name: Ruler, Steward, Headman, and Chamberlain
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler authorizes speech and delegates daily governance to stewards, local heads, and access officers.

subchannels.synthesis: Sovereignty supplies the source of authority, the steward maintains affairs, the headman mediates local knowledge, and the chamberlain governs physical access to the center.

subchannels.name: Watch, Covenant, and Protected Trust
subchannels.scene_or_process: A covenant creates a protected obligation and assigns watchers to preserve it against breach.
subchannels.active_motifs: guarding an entrusted object `ح ف ظ:B001/m01`; preserving covenant and sanctity `ح ف ظ:B006/m01`; covenant held in trust `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; vigilant watcher `ن ظ ر:B009/m01`; supervisory control `س ط ر:B003/m01`.

subchannels.name: Lost Property, Public Identification, and Redress
subchannels.scene_or_process: A stray animal or found object is announced publicly, identified by description, and restored through adjudicative redress.

subchannels.synthesis: Loss creates uncertain ownership, public description tests claims, and adjudication restores the object by linking recognition to an enforceable remedy.

subchannels.name: Bondage, Installment Contract, and Manumission
subchannels.scene_or_process: A subjugated person enters a written installment contract, earns toward its terms, and returns to free status.
subchannels.active_motifs: enslavement and subjugation `د ي ن:B004/m01`; manumission contract `ك ت ب:B005/m01`; earning toward discharge `ك س ب:B001/m01`; return to a former or new condition `ث و ب:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Bondage supplies the initial legal condition, writing specifies staged payment, earning performs the contract, and return names the status change achieved at completion.

subchannels.name: Inheritance, Collateral Kin, and Exclusion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A decedent's estate is distributed among kin while collateral relation and exclusion rules determine shares.

subchannels.synthesis: Kinship defines eligible relations, the decree assigns portions, and exclusion modifies those portions when a nearer or qualifying relation intervenes.

subchannels.name: Delegation, Proxy, and Standing in Another's Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: One person is appointed to occupy another's legal or practical position under a rule of equivalence.
subchannels.active_motifs: acting in another's place `ق و م:B007/m01`; position or station `ك و ن:B002/m01`; matching an equivalent `ن ظ ر:B006/m01`; alignment between representatives `و ز ن:B003/m01`; custodial mandate `ق و م:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Delegation transfers function without erasing the original position. Equivalence legitimizes substitution, while mandate constrains what the proxy may do.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social order is maintained by recognized office, guarded covenant, adjudication, and lawful change of status.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 83:6,15 names lordship, 83:33 guardianship, and 83:7-20 repeatedly joins record with judgment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Authority reaches from ruler, headman, and chamberlain to lost-property procedure, inheritance exclusion, proxy, bondage, and manumission.

parent_channels.name: Household, Kinship, and Social Belonging

subchannels.name: Family Line and Collateral Relation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person belongs to a household through descent, return, collateral relation, and enduring social attachment.
subchannels.active_motifs: household affiliation `ء ه ل:B001/m01`; family line and dependents `ء و ل:B003/m01`; blood kinship `ق ر ب:B003/m01`; collateral kin `ك ل ل:B004/m01`; social tie that holds people together `م س ك:B009/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Descent supplies the close line, collateral kin extends it laterally, and the holding tie makes family a durable social relation rather than a list of names.

subchannels.name: Marriage, Courtship, and Step-Relation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A household is formed through marriage, courtship changes a woman's status, and children enter step-relations.
subchannels.active_motifs: taking a spouse `ء ه ل:B002/m01`; woman approached in courtship `ر س ل:B009/m01`; previously married woman `ث و ب:B005/m01`; stepchild or child reared in another household `ر ب ب:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Courtship initiates the transition, marriage establishes the household, prior marital status shapes the union, and nurture incorporates a child whose relation is social as well as genealogical.

subchannels.name: Human Fellowship and Community
subchannels.scene_or_process: Human presence overcomes estrangement and develops into companionship, sociability, and an assembled community.
subchannels.active_motifs: humanity opposed to wild isolation `ء ن س:B001/m01`; companionship removing loneliness `ء ن س:B003/m01`; relaxed sociability `ر س ل:B007/m01`; gathered people `ق و م:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Recognition of another human first removes fear, repeated presence becomes companionship, and sociability scales that relation into a community.

subchannels.name: Welcome, Gift, and Welfare
subchannels.scene_or_process: A host receives another with spacious welcome, gives material benefit, and turns generosity into durable welfare.
subchannels.active_motifs: expansive greeting and welcome `ء ه ل:B005/m01`; gift or bestowal `ء ل ي:B012/m01`; benefaction and social support `ب ل ل:B002/m01`; kindness to kin `ب ر ر:B003/m01`; abundant generosity `ف ج ر:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Welcome opens social space, the gift fills it with a concrete transfer, and sustained benefaction converts a single reception into welfare and kinship care.

subchannels.name: Notables, Favorites, and Social Prestige
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group distinguishes its notables and grants favored persons proximity, visibility, and honor.
subchannels.active_motifs: elite notables `ع ي ن:B015/m01`; favored intimates of authority `ق ر ب:B004/m01`; social prestige `و ج ه:B006/m01`; honor and sanctity `ع ظ م:B010/m01`; chosen intimate or confidant `ء ن س:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Selection raises certain persons from the wider group, proximity materializes favor, and public prestige makes the resulting hierarchy visible.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: People become socially located through family relation, marriage, shared habitation, hospitality, fellowship, and rank.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 83:2,6 addresses people, 83:21,28 names the near ones, and 83:31 depicts return to one's household.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Household belonging reaches into collateral kin, step-relations, courtship, greeting, benefaction, and privileged intimacy.

parent_channels.name: Mockery, Exposure, and Social Reversal

subchannels.name: Covert Gesture and Fault-Finding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Members of a group identify a target, signal one another covertly, and turn a suspected defect into shared ridicule.
subchannels.active_motifs: covert wink or hand signal `غ م ز:B002/m01`; locating a defect or point of attack `غ م ز:B003/m01`; accusatory suspicion `ظ ن ن:B004/m01`; visible effect of a disparaging look `ن ظ ر:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The signal recruits an audience without open speech, suspicion supplies a fault, and the repeated look marks the target socially and visibly.

subchannels.name: Laughter, Joke, and Amused Talk
subchannels.scene_or_process: Facial expression identifies an object of laughter and develops into shared amusement and witty talk.
subchannels.active_motifs: smiling or laughing face `ض ح ك:B001/m01`; object made laughable `ض ح ك:B002/m01`; delight or astonishment expressed as laughter `ض ح ك:B003/m01`; witty banter `ف ك ه:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Expression makes amusement visible, the laughable target gives it direction, and banter sustains it as a group activity rather than a momentary reaction.

subchannels.name: Shameless Pride and Public Insolence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Social restraint falls away, pride hardens into insolence, and the actor displays contempt before others.
subchannels.active_motifs: shamelessness `ج ح م:B005/m01`; insolent exultation `ف ك ه:B006/m01`; boastful self-magnification `ع ظ م:B006/m01`; arrogant elevation `ع ل و:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Pride supplies the inward valuation, elevation externalizes hierarchy, and shamelessness removes the restraint that would otherwise limit public contempt.

subchannels.name: Returned Derision and Disgrace
subchannels.scene_or_process: The social direction of mockery reverses, and the former observers become the object of laughter and public disgrace.
subchannels.active_motifs: reversal of position `ق ل ب:B004/m01`; recompense returned to the actor `ث و ب:B002/m01`; object of laughter `ض ح ك:B002/m01`; lament of disgrace `و ي ل:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Reversal changes the direction of the gaze, recompense changes the ownership of the act, and laughter exposes those who had treated exposure as their privilege.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social judgment is enacted through covert gesture, laughter, fault-finding, shame, and eventual reversal of who observes whom.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 83:29-36 stages laughter, winking, amused return, accusation, observation, and reversed laughter.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scene extends from a private eyelid signal to public reputation, bodily expression, shamelessness, and returned humiliation.

parent_channels.name: Sight, Appearance, and Epistemic Access

subchannels.name: Looking, Display, and Mutual Facing
subchannels.scene_or_process: An observer directs sight toward a displayed object while participants face one another and share a visible scene.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual or intellectual seeing `ر ء ي:B001/m01`; directed observation `ن ظ ر:B001/m01`; visible presentation `ر ء ي:B012/m01`; mutually facing appearance `ر ء ي:B004/m01`; witnessed presence `ش ه د:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Direction organizes the gaze, display makes the object available, and mutual facing converts solitary perception into a shared encounter.

subchannels.name: Eye, Brow, Pupil, and Reflected Person
subchannels.scene_or_process: The eye is treated as an assembled visual organ whose pupil carries a small reflected human image.
subchannels.active_motifs: seeing eye `ع ي ن:B001/m01`; pupil or seat of sight `ن ظ ر:B008/m01`; human image in the pupil `ء ن س:B005/m01`; eyebrow `ح ج ب:B005/m01`; glaring or protruding eye `ج ح م:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The brow frames the organ, the pupil locates sight, and the reflected person makes vision reciprocal: the observer's eye visibly contains the one observed.

subchannels.name: Blind Eye and Occluded Vision
subchannels.scene_or_process: The eye remains bodily present while access to sight is blocked or covered.
subchannels.active_motifs: blindness as a covered faculty `ح ج ب:B009/m01`; intact but sightless eye `ق و م:B021/m01`; hiddenness from view `ض ل ل:B002/m01`; barrier preventing access `ح ج ب:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The organ persists, but the visual path does not. Covering and hiddenness describe loss of access rather than disappearance of the eye itself.

subchannels.name: Dream, Apparition, and Unstable Appearance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human image appears in sleep or as an uncanny presence whose reality cannot be secured by ordinary sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: dream vision `ر ء ي:B003/m01`; apparition or spirit-companion `ر ء ي:B008/m01`; human presence opposed to the uncanny `ء ن س:B001/m01`; pupil image `ء ن س:B005/m01`; inescapable entrapment `ر ي ن:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Dream and apparition imitate ordinary appearance without granting ordinary verification. The reflected human image supplies a visual analogy, while entrapment captures the apparition's grip on the perceiver.

subchannels.name: Harmful Gaze and Bodily Impact
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gaze is believed to strike another person, leaving a visible defect or inward injury.
subchannels.active_motifs: injurious evil eye `ع ي ن:B004/m01`; harmful force issuing from a person `ن ف س:B003/m01`; injury reaching the heart `ق ل ب:B016/m01`; discoloring defect left by a look `ن ظ ر:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The gaze functions as an agent, the person supplies its force, and the victim's body or color records the effect. Perception thus reverses into causation.

subchannels.name: Watcher, Spy, and Surveillance
subchannels.scene_or_process: An appointed observer watches continuously, gathers hidden information, and reports it to authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: watcher preserving a trust `ن ظ ر:B009/m01`; spy as an observing eye `ع ي ن:B005/m01`; vigilant alertness `ح ف ظ:B004/m01`; supervisory control `س ط ر:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Vigilance sustains attention, the spy crosses the boundary between visible and hidden information, and supervision turns observation into institutional control.

subchannels.name: Knowledge, Recognition, and Evidential Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A trace is perceived, interpreted, and converted into recognition, knowledge, or warranted certainty.
subchannels.active_motifs: practical knowledge `د ر ي:B001/m01`; disclosed knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; recognition from a trace `ع ر ف:B003/m01`; certainty following an indication `ظ ن ن:B001/m01`; informed testimony `ش ه د:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The trace initiates inference, recognition identifies the object, and testimony makes the resulting knowledge available to others. Certainty is the endpoint of interpreted evidence.

subchannels.name: Suspicion, Divination, and Hidden Knowledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Uncertain signs are read by a specialist who claims access to concealed outcomes, sometimes through animal omens.
subchannels.active_motifs: doubt and conjecture `ظ ن ن:B003/m01`; untrustworthy outcome `ظ ن ن:B006/m01`; diviner claiming hidden knowledge `ع ر ف:B012/m01`; specialist or learned sage `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; raptor used within the omen field `ع ل م:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Uncertainty creates demand for interpretation, the specialist claims to resolve it, and the raptor supplies a mobile sign whose behavior can be read as an omen.

subchannels.name: Memory, Inner Retention, and Forgetting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Perceived or spoken content is held in the mind, rehearsed inwardly, or lost through forgetting.
subchannels.active_motifs: stable retention in memory `ح ف ظ:B002/m01`; loss of remembered content `ض ل ل:B004/m01`; inner unspoken statement `ق و ل:B012/m01`; mind and inward awareness `ن ف س:B013/m01`; reflective opinion `ر ء ي:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Attention admits content, inward speech rehearses it, retention keeps it available, and forgetting breaks the link between prior perception and present recall.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Knowledge depends on what can be seen, displayed, recognized, inferred, concealed, or watched.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; seeing at 83:32, looking at 83:23,35, recognition at 83:24, witnessing at 83:21, and supposition at 83:4 form an explicit epistemic field.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Visual knowledge reaches into eye anatomy, reflected human images, dream, apparition, harmful gaze, espionage, divination, and omen-bearing birds.

parent_channels.name: Living Body, Reproduction, Injury, and Recovery

subchannels.name: Heart, Lung, Breath, and Life
subchannels.scene_or_process: Breath moves through the chest, lungs sustain respiration, and the heart stands as the inward center of embodied life.
subchannels.active_motifs: heart or inward organ `ق ل ب:B001/m01`; lung and pulmonary distress `ر ء ي:B009/m01`; exhaled breath `ن ف س:B001/m01`; living self `ن ف س:B011/m01`; diaphragm or inner partition `ح ج ب:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The diaphragm partitions the chest, the lung moves breath across that interior, and heart and living self supply the vital center whose failure would end the process.

subchannels.name: Constitution, Physique, and Bodily Proportion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body is composed according to temperament, bulk, bone, stature, and proportional balance.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily temperament and composition `م ز ج:B002/m01`; bodily mass and size `ج ر م:B007/m01`; main bulk of a thing `ع ظ م:B002/m01`; hard bone `ع ظ م:B005/m01`; stature and bodily frame `ق و م:B011/m01`; proportionate formation `و ز ن:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Temperament describes internal mixture, bone and bulk provide material structure, and stature displays how those components have been proportioned into a body.

subchannels.name: Mouth, Lip, Tongue, and Tooth
subchannels.scene_or_process: The mouth is assembled from lip, tongue, tooth, mustache, and throat passages that jointly shape expression and intake.
subchannels.active_motifs: cleft in the upper lip `ع ل م:B004/m01`; inverted or deformed lip `ق ل ب:B012/m01`; tongue as articulator `ق و ل:B002/m01`; mustache and throat channels `ش ر ب:B006/m01`; visible tooth `ض ح ك:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Lip and tooth frame the opening, tongue shapes outgoing speech, and throat channels regulate what passes inward. Visible expression and ingestion share the same bodily threshold.

subchannels.name: Chest, Pelvis, Flank, and Back
subchannels.scene_or_process: The torso is mapped through chest, pelvic heads, flank, lower back, and variations in bodily thickness.
subchannels.active_motifs: chest `ك ل ل:B007/m01`; heads of the pelvic bones `ح ج ب:B006/m01`; flank or waist `ق ر ب:B015/m01`; lower back and tail-root `ص ل ي:B006/m01`; short thick build `ك ل ل:B008/m01`; enlarged buttock pad `ع ظ م:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs form a contiguous body map from chest through waist and pelvis to the lower back. Thickness and artificial enlargement describe how that frame can vary in profile.

subchannels.name: Pregnancy, Birth, Afterbirth, and Nursing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Gestation approaches delivery, the young presents in a particular orientation, and membranes and afterbirth accompany emergence and early care.
subchannels.active_motifs: approaching parturition `ق ر ب:B012/m01`; visible pregnancy `ر ء ي:B010/m01`; lochia and childbirth discharge `ن ف س:B005/m01`; afterbirth accompanying the newborn `ش ه د:B006/m01`; forelimbs-first animal presentation `و ج ه:B010/m01`; birth membrane on the young `م س ك:B010/m01`; womb's holding bond `م س ك:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Pregnancy becomes visible, nearness signals labor, presentation governs the mechanics of delivery, and membranes and discharge mark the transition from gestation to newborn care.

subchannels.name: Disease, Nausea, and Bodily Injury
subchannels.scene_or_process: Illness disturbs internal mixture, movement, or an organ and may culminate in a direct strike to the heart or face.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily nausea `ر ي ن:B004/m01`; bitter bodily humor `م ر ر:B007/m01`; heart disease `ق ل ب:B011/m01`; persistent pain in a limb `ق و م:B019/m01`; contagious disease `ع د و:B006/m01`; injury to the heart `ق ل ب:B016/m01`; harmful draught `س ق ي:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Nausea and bitter humor describe internal disturbance, limb pain and disease alter bodily function, and the heart-strike gives the channel an acute traumatic endpoint.

subchannels.name: Wound Repair, Convalescence, and Relief
subchannels.scene_or_process: A wound settles, a thick medicinal preparation repairs tissue or leather, and the patient rises out of illness into relief.
subchannels.active_motifs: healed and quieted wound `ء ر ك:B005/m01`; thick medicinal or repair syrup `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; recovery from illness `ب ل ل:B003/m01`; recovery after childbirth or disease `ع ل و:B011/m01`; release from distress `ن ف س:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Repair begins with a material preparation, continues as swelling and corruption subside, and ends when the body regains its prior level and distress opens into relief.

subchannels.name: Viscera, Flank, and Soft Abdominal Tissue
subchannels.scene_or_process: The abdomen is mapped through entrails, diaphragm, flank, and loose external tissue.
subchannels.active_motifs: intestines `م ر ر:B008/m01`; loose abdominal flesh `ط ف ف:B008/m01`; inner diaphragm `ح ج ب:B004/m01`; flank and waist `ق ر ب:B015/m01`; rendered body fat `ء ه ل:B006/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The diaphragm marks the upper interior, entrails occupy the visceral center, flank locates the side wall, and loose tissue and fat describe the abdomen's outer material.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life is embodied through breath, organs, bodily proportion, reproduction, vulnerability, and restoration.

parent_channels.name: Water, Drinking, and Vessel Technology

subchannels.name: Drinking, Share, and Draught
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is allocated as a share, presented at a drinking place, and consumed in successive draughts.

subchannels.synthesis: Allocation determines who drinks, the vessel or place stages access, and successive draughts turn a communal resource into embodied refreshment.

subchannels.name: Spring, Well, Reservoir, and Water-Holding Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water emerges, gathers in a deep or stable place, and is retained for use.
subchannels.active_motifs: flowing spring `ع ي ن:B006/m01`; well or water pit `ق ل ب:B007/m01`; deep abundant water `ع ل م:B005/m01`; accumulated fresh water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; water-retaining ground or well lining `م س ك:B004/m01`; fissure releasing water `ف ج ر:B001/m01`.

subchannels.name: Waterskin, Leak, Tanning, and Repair
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hide is made into a water container, lightly tanned, tested for leaks, and sealed by wetting its seams.
subchannels.active_motifs: waterskin container `ق ر ب:B009/m01`; hide retaining contents `م س ك:B005/m01`; thin or leaking point in a skin `ع ي ن:B007/m01`; conditioning and sealing a waterskin `ش ر ب:B013/m01`; small tanning application `ن ف س:B007/m01`; thick repair compound `ر ب ب:B006/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Tanning creates a durable hide, inspection locates the weak point, wet clay or thick compound closes the stitching, and the finished skin becomes a portable water store.

subchannels.name: Chosen Drink and Admixture
subchannels.scene_or_process: A selected clear drink receives an admixture that changes its flavor, body, or effect.
subchannels.active_motifs: choice clear nectar `ر ح ق:B001/m01`; mixing one liquid with another `م ز ج:B001/m01`; liquid consumed `ش ر ب:B001/m01`; sustaining mixture `م س ك:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Selection establishes purity, admixture modifies the chosen base, and drinking completes the transformation from prepared liquid to experienced taste and effect.

subchannels.name: Bitter or Harmful Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: A drinker faces water that is bitter, repellent, or barely sufficient to sustain life.
subchannels.active_motifs: reluctantly consumed water `ش ر ب:B005/m01`; bitterness opposed to sweetness `م ر ر:B003/m01`; water just sufficient for life `ن ف س:B008/m01`; a hateful drink striking the heart `س ق ي:B010/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Scarcity makes the drink necessary, bitterness makes it resistant to desire, and bodily harm turns hydration into ordeal.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water becomes usable through source, allocation, drinking, mixture, storage, and maintenance of containers.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 83:25-28 presents being given drink, a sealed beverage, admixture, a spring, and drinking.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The liquid scene expands into wells, reservoirs, throat passages, leather tanning, leaking skins, and bitter survival water.

parent_channels.name: Cultivation, Fruit, and Prepared Food

subchannels.name: Covered Seed and First Watering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seed is covered in soil, receives its first irrigation, and opens into growth.

subchannels.name: Grain, Ear, and Ripening Color
subchannels.scene_or_process: Grain rises into an ear and changes color as it matures toward harvest.

subchannels.active_motifs: aloeswood incense `ء ل ي:B014/m01`; camphor fragrance `ك ف ر:B011/m01`; recognizing and applying scent `ع ر ف:B004/m01`; smoldering fuel `ص ل ي:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Aromatic material is selected, heat releases its scent, and smell extends the crafted object beyond its physical boundary into the surrounding space.

subchannels.name: Anvil, Spear Tip, and Grinding Slab
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hard stone or metal provides a resistant surface for pounding, sharpening, and forming tools.
subchannels.active_motifs: anvil or raised stone `ع ل و:B009/m01`; spear point `ع ل و:B009/m02`; grinding slab `ص ل ي:B009/m01`; hard uneven ground as resistant material `ع د و:B010/m01`; pointed cutting implement `د ر ي:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Resistance makes pounding possible, the slab receives repeated impact, and sharpening concentrates force into an edge or point.

subchannels.name: Blade, Handle, Sheath, and Point
subchannels.scene_or_process: An edged weapon is assembled from blade and standing handle, sharpened at its point, and stored in a fitted sheath.
subchannels.active_motifs: sword or knife sheath `ق ر ب:B010/m01`; standing sword component `ق و م:B012/m02`; sword's projecting lip or edge `ش ر ب:B006/m02`; pointed implement `د ر ي:B004/m01`; spear point `ع ل و:B009/m02`.
subchannels.synthesis: Handle controls the blade, sharpening concentrates force at the edge or point, and the sheath encloses the finished weapon between uses.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Raw wood, fiber, hide, pigment, stone, metal, and fragrance are transformed into functional or status-bearing objects.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; sealing, inscription, color, musk, couches, and drink vessels provide surface anchors for a broad lexical craft field.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The craft field includes tent poles, bier, saddle wood, twisted rope, deceptive cloth, bracelet, coronation crown, pure gold, aloeswood incense, anvil, spear tip, and grinding slab.

parent_channels.name: Dispatch, Passage, Return, and Navigation

subchannels.name: Rousing, Dispatch, and Messenger
subchannels.scene_or_process: A still agent is activated, given a direction, and sent as a messenger toward a task.
subchannels.active_motifs: rousing from stillness `ب ع ث:B001/m01`; commissioning and dispatch `ب ع ث:B002/m01`; sending forth `ر س ل:B001/m01`; messenger and message `ر س ل:B002/m01`; rising to undertake an affair `ق و م:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Activation creates readiness, commissioning supplies purpose, and sending converts intention into directed movement carried by an identified messenger.

subchannels.name: Passage, Following, and Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler passes a point, follows a prior movement, turns, and returns to a former place or condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: passage and crossing `م ر ر:B001/m01`; following in succession `ت ل و:B001/m01`; return to a place or state `ث و ب:B001/m01`; turning back `ق ل ب:B005/m01`; movement beyond or around `ع د و:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Passage marks departure from one point, following supplies order, and turning transforms outward movement into return.

subchannels.name: Collective Rush and Scattering
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group is stirred into rapid motion, moves in waves, and may scatter under pressure.
subchannels.active_motifs: collective surge `ب ع ث:B004/m01`; sudden outpouring `ف ج ر:B003/m01`; successive moving groups `ر س ل:B005/m01`; group dispersal `ن ع م:B008/m01`; mixed commotion `ب ل ل:B009/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Activation starts the surge, successive waves preserve some order, and scattering marks the point where collective motion exceeds coordination.

subchannels.name: Approach, Appointment, and Arrival
subchannels.scene_or_process: A destination or appointed meeting draws near, the traveler adopts a direction, and participants arrive together.
subchannels.active_motifs: approach and nearness `ق ر ب:B001/m01`; approaching time `ق ر ب:B002/m01`; arriving for an appointment `و ف ي:B004/m01`; aiming toward a destination `د ر ي:B002/m01`; directional face `و ج ه:B002/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Direction aligns movement, nearness measures remaining distance or time, and arrival fulfills the appointment by gathering participants at one place.

subchannels.name: Small Boat, Captain, and Paced Travel
subchannels.scene_or_process: A small craft carries passengers under a captain who regulates speed and course.
subchannels.active_motifs: small boat `ق ر ب:B011/m01`; captain or master of sailors `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; smooth travel `ر س ل:B003/m01`; deliberate pacing `ر س ل:B004/m01`; high lookout `و ف ي:B003/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: The boat supplies transport, the captain supplies coordinated command, pacing moderates movement, and the lookout converts elevation into navigational awareness.

subchannels.name: Repulse, Redirection, and Reversal of Course
subchannels.scene_or_process: An approaching person or action is turned away, breaks its prior following relation, and takes a reversed course.
subchannels.active_motifs: repelling from the face or front `و ج ه:B014/m01`; leaving after accompaniment `ت ل و:B005/m01`; turning a thing from its face `ق ل ب:B004/m01`; meeting an appointment and then separating `و ف ي:B004/m01`; redirected passage `ع د و:B004/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Repulse blocks forward approach, reversal changes orientation, and abandonment ends the prior relation of following or accompaniment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Motion is organized by activation, sending, route, succession, arrival, return, and control of a vehicle.
parent_channels.surface_relation: mixed; 83:4 names being raised, 83:30 passing by, 83:31 returning, and 83:33 being sent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The movement field reaches from messenger and collective rush to paced travel, a small boat, and its captain.

parent_channels.name: Resolve, Rank, Affect, and Capacity

subchannels.name: Effort, Capacity, and Firm Resolve
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent has the capacity to act, exerts effort, rises to the task, and sustains firm resolve.
subchannels.active_motifs: strenuous effort `ء ل ي:B010/m01`; capacity and ability `ء ل ي:B011/m01`; undertaking an affair `ق و م:B003/m01`; firm determination `م ر ر:B006/m01`; strength of character `ن ف س:B014/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity makes action possible, effort initiates it, and resolve preserves the undertaking when resistance appears.

subchannels.name: Composure, Alertness, and Deliberate Pace
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person remains inwardly steady, watches carefully, and acts without impulsive haste.
subchannels.active_motifs: patient composed self `ع ر ف:B010/m01`; vigilant alertness `ح ف ظ:B004/m01`; gentleness and deliberation `ر س ل:B004/m01`; secure heart `ء م ن:B001/m01`; balanced judgment `و ز ن:B005/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Security quiets fear, alertness preserves attention, and measured judgment lets action proceed at a deliberate pace.

subchannels.name: Honor, Awe, and Social Weight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or affair is perceived as great, elevated, and worthy of deference.
subchannels.active_motifs: greatness and strength `ع ظ م:B001/m01`; awe before magnitude `ع ظ م:B007/m01`; honor and sanctity `ع ظ م:B010/m01`; elevated rank `ع ل و:B002/m01`; social prestige `و ج ه:B006/m01`; recognized weight or standing `و ز ن:B007/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Magnitude generates awe, elevation establishes rank, and social weight converts those perceptions into durable prestige.

subchannels.name: Pride, Domination, and Overreaching
subchannels.scene_or_process: Self-magnification becomes arrogance and seeks confirmation through domination over others.
subchannels.active_motifs: boastful self-enlargement `ع ظ م:B006/m01`; arrogant elevation `ع ل و:B003/m01`; domination and conquest `ع ل و:B004/m01`; insolent exultation `ف ك ه:B006/m01`; prevailing over another `ب ر ر:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Pride changes self-estimation, arrogance places the self above others, and domination attempts to make that imagined hierarchy materially true.

subchannels.name: Comfort, Softness, and Radiant Well-Being
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ease of condition produces bodily softness, inward delight, recovery, and visible radiance.
subchannels.active_motifs: good condition and blessing `ن ع م:B001/m01`; softness and ease `ن ع م:B002/m01`; delightful well-being `ف ك ه:B001/m01`; generous ease `ر س ل:B010/m01`; recovery from illness `ب ل ل:B003/m01`; radiant beauty `ن ض ر:B001/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Relief removes hardship, ease settles into bodily softness, delight supplies inward experience, and radiance makes well-being visible on the face.

subchannels.name: Fatigue, Helplessness, and Diminished Agency
subchannels.scene_or_process: Capacity declines through dullness, fatigue, weakness, or smallness until action stalls.
subchannels.active_motifs: blunt fatigue `ك ل ل:B001/m01`; helpless weakness `ظ ن ن:B008/m01`; stopping through weariness `ق و م:B016/m01`; slightness or paucity `ط ف ف:B001/m01`; slackened effort `ء ل ي:B008/m01`.
subchannels.synthesis: Slight capacity reduces force, fatigue blunts continuation, and helplessness turns a temporary pause into inability to complete the act.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A person's ability to act is shaped by vigor, composure, fatigue, self-estimation, honor, and comfort.
parent_channels.surface_relation: mixed; 83:5 calls the day great, 83:18-19 names elevation, 83:22-24 bliss and radiance, and 83:26 competition.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Inner condition ranges from patient composure and alertness to helplessness, pride, conquest, bodily softness, and luminous well-being.

parent_channels.name: S1. Lot Gambling with Ranked Arrows
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Gaming arrows are kept in a container, drawn by lot, and distinguished by ranked identity and stake tokens.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather container for gaming arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; grouped lot arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`; fifth gaming arrow `ن ف س:B016/m01`; elevated or favored lot arrow `ع ل و:B009/m03`; smooth nut used as a counting or value token `خ ت م:B007/m01`.
parent_channels.synthesis: The container organizes the arrows, rank differentiates their outcomes, drawing converts uncertainty into allocation, and the smooth token gives the result a countable stake.

parent_channels.name: S2. Qillah Bat-and-Target Play
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A player uses a shaped wooden bat to strike the qillah in a compact recreation scene.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wooden striking bat `ق و ل:B008/m01`; struck qillah as the bat's target `ق و ل:B008/m02`.
parent_channels.synthesis: One lexical evidence container preserves both indispensable roles of the game: the hand-held striking tool and the small target it propels.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
